latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the CamScanner Image Remove Watermark skill.

- Removes watermarks, stamps, and translucent logos from images while preserving original layout and content.
- Three-step workflow: upload image, enhance (remove watermark), and download the cleaned result.
- Supports both standard (file_id) and one-shot (raw image stream) output modes.
- Provides clear CLI examples and error handling guidance.
- Requires curl and jq; files processed by CamScanner servers and saved locally.
